WITH region_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
region_shares AS (
    SELECT region, client_count,
           1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM region_counts
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM region_shares
)
SELECT SUM(rs.client_count) AS total_client_count,
       AVG(rs.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(rs.share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM region_shares AS rs
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE rs.share > a.avg_share;
